summary: Result.Int()/Uint() wrap around instead of clamping when the JSON number or numeric string is out of range.

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream fix; the fix is never reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.reference_patch_note: Upstream's added TestIntOverflow asserts Go float->int conversion results that are implementation-defined (it fails on windows/amd64 with Go 1.27), so that hunk is omitted from the reference patch; the source change and the update of the pre-existing wrap-around expectations are kept verbatim.

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
